about: UX-ZONE-NOTES (decision 0030): AshLight-written levelling notes, one per campaign zone, keyed by act key and zone name as the log names it. Own words only: no wiki or poe2db prose (decision 0009). General guidance, not yet checked in play.

G1.default: Act 1: follow the road north and clear toward the act boss; keep your resistances in mind.

zones.The Riverbank: First zone: grab a weapon, follow the river and beat the boss at its end.
zones.Clearfell Encampment: Town: sell junk, check the vendors for a better weapon, then head out.
zones.Clearfell: Open woods: the Mud Burrow entrance is here; clear on toward the Grelwood.
zones.Mud Burrow: Short cave with a boss at the bottom; worth it early for the experience.
zones.The Grelwood: Big forest hub: several paths branch off here; take the main road first.
zones.The Red Vale: Optional side zone: a tougher fight with a reward; skip it if you are rushing.
zones.The Grim Tangle: Dense, dark thicket: move steadily and look for the way down to the cemetery.
zones.Cemetery of the Eternals: Hub for two tombs: both side zones hold what you need to go on.
zones.Mausoleum of the Praetor: Side tomb: clear to the end for the item that opens the way on.
zones.Tomb of the Consort: Side tomb: clear to the end for the second item that opens the way on.
zones.Hunting Grounds: Open grounds: the side path to Freythorn starts here; the road leads on.
zones.Freythorn: Optional side zone with a ritual fight; the reward is worth the detour.
zones.Ogham Farmlands: Farms before the village: look around for a quest item along the way.
zones.Ogham Village: Burning village: push through to the manor gates.
zones.The Manor Ramparts: Walls of the manor: clear the ramparts to reach the door.
zones.Ogham Manor: Act boss inside: check resistances and flasks before you go in.

G2.default: Act 2: desert travel by caravan; clear the side zones you need and head for the act boss.

zones.Vastiri Outskirts: Desert edge: follow the road to the caravan.
zones.The Ardura Caravan: Moving town: vendors and travel to the next zone are here.
zones.Traitor's Passage: Cave passage with a boss; it opens the way deeper into the desert.
zones.The Halani Gates: Gate fight: clear the way through to continue the act.
zones.Keth: Ruined city: explore toward the Lost City below.
zones.The Lost City: Underground ruins: push through to the shrines.
zones.Buried Shrines: Shrine boss at the end; take your time with its attacks.
zones.Mastodon Badlands: Open badlands: find the way down into the Bone Pits.
zones.The Bone Pits: Pit boss at the bottom; its drop moves the act on.
zones.Valley of the Titans: Large valley: look for the item that opens the way to the grotto.
zones.The Titan Grotto: Cave with a boss; check your life flask before the fight.
zones.Deshar: Ruined city on the way to the spires; clear forward.
zones.Path of Mourning: Long climb: keep moving toward the spires.
zones.The Spires of Deshar: High spires: clear to the top to move the act on.
zones.Mawdun Quarry: Quarry: fight down toward the mine.
zones.Mawdun Mine: Mine with a boss at the end; it unlocks the way forward.
zones.The Dreadnought's Wake: The trail of the great war machine: clear through to it.
zones.Dreadnought: Act boss aboard the war machine: cap your resistances and refill flasks first.

G3.default: Act 3: jungle and old Vaal ruins; clear toward the city and the act boss.

zones.Sandswept Marsh: Marsh path: follow it to the next camp.
zones.Ziggurat Encampment: Town on the ziggurat: vendors, then out into the jungle.
zones.Jungle Ruins: Jungle hub with a boss; several paths start here.
zones.The Venom Crypts: Poison crypt: chaos resistance helps; look for the quest item.
zones.Infested Barrens: Barren ground: clear forward toward the waterways.
zones.Chimeral Wetlands: Wetlands with a boss; it opens the way to the temple.
zones.Jiquani's Machinarium: Old machine halls: power the way through to the sanctum.
zones.Jiquani's Sanctum: Sanctum with a fight at the end; it moves the act on.
zones.The Azak Bog: Optional bog with a ritual fight; the reward is worth the detour.
zones.The Matlan Waterways: Waterways: open the flow to reach the drowned city.
zones.The Drowned City: Sunken city: clear through toward the vault.
zones.The Molten Vault: Hot vault: watch fire damage, then push to the end.
zones.Apex of Filth: Boss at the top of the filth: take it slowly.
zones.Temple of Kopec: Temple climb with a boss; fire resistance helps.
zones.Utzaal: The old city: clear through toward Aggorat.
zones.Aggorat: City heart: push on to the black chambers.
zones.The Black Chambers: Act boss below: cap resistances and refill flasks before you go.

G4.default: Act 4: island hopping by ship; clear the islands you need and head for the act boss.

zones.Kingsmarch: Port town: vendors and the ship to the islands.
zones.Isle of Kin: First island: clear it and look for the cave inside.
zones.Volcanic Warrens: Volcanic caves: watch fire damage on the way through.
zones.Kedge Bay: Bay island: clear it and move on.
zones.Journey's End: Island with a fight at its end; it moves the act on.
zones.Whakapanu Island: Island with caves; clear through to the inner cave.
zones.Singing Caverns: Cave with a boss at the end.
zones.Abandoned Prison: Prison island: clear down toward the cells.
zones.Solitary Confinement: Prison depths with a boss; check flasks first.
zones.Eye of Hinekora: Sacred island: follow the path inward.
zones.Halls of the Dead: Halls with trials; take them one at a time.
zones.Shrike Island: Bird island: clear it and look for its fight.
zones.Arastas: Ruins on the way to the end of the act; clear forward.
zones.The Excavation: Dig site: push down to its end.

P1.default: Interlude: a side story between acts; follow the main path and beat its boss before you move on.

P2.default: Interlude: a side story between acts; follow the main path and beat its boss before you move on.

P3.default: Interlude: a side story between acts; follow the main path and beat its boss before you move on.

C.default: Cruel difficulty: the same act again with harder monsters; raise your resistances first.
